book.title: Genesis Mosesna Moamba Memba, Indhanana Pholmomba.

content: Isakva Gerarra Avna.
Doa owousva phovna petharava diva, indanampetam seilva Aprahamna novrava.

Wo Yawe nonglaphona, Isakm ishomnavna, manam yimba honamba pethamba wuleihavav, wo manam yimba Isip petharamba wongavav. Si yemba ka indthoamnavav, ora honinda ao, wo si yemba kava waiavav, kolvrevav.
Doa honamba pethava si yemba kava kovorahunvav, yem yetindim, seilm nemet ten kava Apraham ishomnanam arapevm.
Si yetindiva mindnam phovav paimsna, wo si kava kovorahunvav hona pethava.

Indhanamba indkumbiva si hemba nungeilvrava, doa himba eva kamba sah ovrivra, kamoa eva os vinuta yeoa, Isaktindim ten pev vinnam. Arapevpa yenamba Aprahamba kana moam engvna, eva kana lohohmom engvna, wo noinda yemba kava kolvrevav. Doa Isakva hellenamba Sesoamba, wo Apimelekm enggana Gerar kembellam, Apimelekva nomba kuwul mendekli wulluhunvna Pilistianindna.

Doa Isakva ongali ahavna di Gerarra Apimelekinda. Tendomba nonamba osihminivnamba hena ongalmba, himba os unvna, memba kana muskovol. Himba pem vevna, ishunilmba, osva memba kana ongal, osra ata kamba helvakomandhivav, wo kana ongalva pelvreivav hevm. Ongalva besal hevm amnavna.
Doa sism Apimelek hevna eneshatuvra novvelohvna amballam, nongalna, pai, Isakva Repekam waiav.

Doa ona, Isakm umnu, prora hom, ka sah ovrei. Doa Isakva pronamba, Apimelek omnana, Repekava yena ongalma a, muskopevmi? Es hevpa yimba kamba gekalava omnavna, osva kana muskovol. Doa Isak omnana, os kava nengna, kava osva untava, kana ongal, ata yimba kamba helvakomandhivav.
Doa Apimelek omnana, yimba honamba kamba sahonam vinvna. Osva mongova kariniva wailitava yena ongapevmba, wo osva mendekli ata indkoklawonam kainamba lohta.
Doa Apimelek ishonga vinna indkumbim, os mongova kevratava Isaknamba ongalmba, henomba kava helvakomandhavav.
Isak Ditowond Lohvna.
Doa Isak osora innemba koko venamba, wo esvema phona, manara Yawe kolvrena. Himba osangas vaomana vevna, espeta wolavna, wo innemba mindnam phomnavna,
wo himba ditowondva noinda lohvna.
Sipsipva sapiva esvema lovahmanavna, wo andranindva himba mindnam wonavna. Wo noinda nomba Pilistianindva hemba mueumb vinivna.
Doa himba angawul venamba, tovalpva nomba Aprahamna andranind doara tovawol vinam, noindava himba hon dembhapuv vinamba, pundind vewol wohvinna.
Doa Apimelek Isakm ishomnana, yeoa pulvo hona petharinioa, yetindiva doa mindnam phona, wo keknamangas lovahv, andra viv.
Doa Isakva wonganamba, di aevulthana Gerarpundra, di dawonam wonalohvna.

Doa himba henga tovalpva wontovawol wonvena, nomba aralva nemetva temba wontovawol wonvenamba, Pilistianindva doara honmba pundind vewol vinna. Nemet aral ten nengsm ovna tovalpmba nomba, wo Isakva osta eva henga sevel ovna.
Doa Isakna andranind henga mel mongo tuveinamba, pom kihie.
Wo sism himba dahwol vivna sipsipmba Isaknamba, Gerarnindva himba ambvnamba, koasromb vi, unna, memba pomba kana, yenamba owai. Doa Isakva os tovalpmba nomba sevravna Esek, osm ovna, koasromb.
Doa henga mel mongo tuveinamba, doa henga indhanamba ambanamba, koasromb vie. Doa Isakva os tovalpmba nomba sevravna Sitna, osm ovna, daosmoa.

Doa Isakva nominiva wonganamba, indanam di wonavhoana, henga tovalp mongo wontovo, wo indhanamba hemba tandwol vinamoa, noinda os tovalpmba nomba sevravna Rehopot, osm ovna, beswonam aevulv. Ona, Yawe hev pimba doa sandhana besal pethara, si pimba beswonam indwonam wohaevulvav.
Doa nominiva Isakva wonganamba, di wonpho Bersepara.

Doa sinim Yawe phomna, omnana, kava Sesoa, ten Apraham arapev sembayang kam vaomana venavnam, manam yimba pemba vevav, yemba kava waiavav, wo awothovav, wo yetindiva si mindnam phovav, noinda kava doara arapevmba wohishomnana, himba kana andranindrini lohvna.
Doa Isakva hellenamba, hon songowol venamba, di sembayang vaomanavna. Doa lailduvpa di vewol wonvena, wo andranind henga mongo tovalpva tuveina.
Isakiva Apimeleki Mongawulm Wohihishona.
Doa Apimelekva mendekli hevnamini Gerarrini prona, Isakm engprana. Wo hevna mendekli samblam wonprona, vei Ahusatm nonoanindrinim, eva valgonindna kuwulm Pikolm.
Wonphonamba, Isakva unna, es hevpa yimba kamba engambei, seilva yimba kamba os umnina, kembeloa honaoa wuleihu, yimba beswonamba kamba wonishonamoa.
Doa hev una, doa kava liheiv, Yawe yemba tanamolnam kolvrev, wo kava yemongom moam isholm viv, osm pimba beswonam aevluwul vevav. Yeoa tanamolnam kamoa ishunu,

osva yimba si kamba helvawol vivavmoa. Nemetva seilva yimba kamba wonavnamba, kava yemba tandwol vivnamoa, yemba helvawol vinamoa. Kava yemba nungtina, beswonam indwonam, wo doa Yaweva yemba beswonam vewol vev.
Doa Isakva hellenamba, innemba mendekli meilna vevna, doa os dahwol vena innena pona.
Doa simolnam hev indkumbi nomba moamba wohmokeltheivna, doa hev una, Sesoa hev pimba nongalvav, ora tanamolnam ishuv. Doa himba beswonam aevulvna, wo Isak samblamong indhanam nom wolanga vena.
Doa Isakna andranindva nonamba ambna, umnina, doa kava pomba kihei.
Wo Isakva os sevravna, memba tovalpva Sipa, osm ovna, tanamolnam wohishuv. Wo noinda indhanamba no kembelmba osva mendah ningthiv, Bersepa, osm ovna, memba tovalpva tanamolmoa.
Doa Esau yiveltowondva osomba 40pelara venamba, ongamba sambla dombtna, ungund ongorini samblam Hitnindongo. Mongova Yutit, Berina mol, mongova Basemat, Elonna mol.
Doa Isakiva Repekaiva himba sahonam enenginvna honamba ungund ongorini samblamba.
